OVERTIME.name: Overtime

references.title: PP 35/2021 arts.31–32: the overtime hour is 1/173 of the monthly wage (art.32(2)), on basic plus fixed allowances (art.32(3), `terms.monthly_wage`). Each day of the attendance window (`work.days`) is priced on its overtime (an order and the worker's consent, art.28), derived from the recorded clock: on an ordinary working day the hours past the planned shift (`overtime_hours`), the first at 1.5× and every further hour at 2× (art.31(1)); on a weekly rest day or an official holiday (`holiday_kind`) every hour worked is overtime — every paid hour of the day (`worked_hours`: on a holiday that falls on a working day the planned shift plus the time past it, on a 0-hour rest or off day all its hours) less hours banked as time off, each hour counted once — for a 6-day / 40-hour week hours 1–7 at 2×, hour 8 at 3×, hours 9–11 at 4× (art.31(2)(a)), and when the holiday falls on the shortest working day (scheduled 5 hours or less) hours 1–5 at 2×, hour 6 at 3×, hours 7–9 at 4× (art.31(2)(b)); for a 5-day / 40-hour week hours 1–8 at 2×, hour 9 at 3×, hours 10–12 at 4× (art.31(3)). The week is the terms fact `working_days_per_week` (5 or 6); a rest-day or holiday hour without it refuses. Hours beyond the last listed hour stay at 4× (the article lists none beyond; the art.26 daily limit keeps them rare). A daily-paid worker's month is the agreed daily wage × 25 on a 6-day week or × 21 on a 5-day week (art.33(1)). No overtime wage for a golongan jabatan tertentu (art.27(2)–(3), `MANAGERIAL`) — only where the agreement, company regulation or collective agreement defines that group (art.27(4)–(5)). https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf Where basic plus fixed allowances are below 75% of the whole wage (customer input `terms.facts.non_fixed_allowances_monthly`), the base is 75% of the whole wage (art.32(4)). PP 35/2021 art.27(2)–(5): the golongan jabatan tertentu is exempt only where the employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement defines it (`company.facts.managerial_group_defined`); otherwise a MANAGERIAL worker is paid overtime. Art.33(2)–(3): output pay (PIECE_RATE) takes the average of the last 12 months (`earned.months`, gross less overtime), floored at the worksite minimum wage.

OVERTIME.eligibility:
work.days.exists(
  d,
  ((d.day_type == "WORK" || d.day_type == "") && d.holiday_kind == ""
    ?d.overtime_hours
    :d.worked_hours - d.banked_hours)
  >0.0
)
&&!(terms.work_classification == "MANAGERIAL"
&&has(company.facts.managerial_group_defined)
&&company.facts.managerial_group_defined == true)
OVERTIME.quantity:
sum(
  work.days.map(
    d,
    ((d.day_type == "WORK" || d.day_type == "") && d.holiday_kind == ""
      ?d.overtime_hours
      :d.worked_hours - d.banked_hours)
    <=0.0
      ?0.0
      : ((d.day_type == "WORK" || d.day_type == "")
      &&d.holiday_kind == ""
        ?ladder(d.overtime_hours, [[1.0, 1.5], [null, 2.0]])
        : (terms.facts.working_days_per_week == 6.0
          ? (d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours <= 5.0
            ?ladder(
              d.worked_hours - d.banked_hours,
              [[5.0, 2.0], [6.0, 3.0], [null, 4.0]]
            )
            :ladder(
              d.worked_hours - d.banked_hours,
              [[7.0, 2.0], [8.0, 3.0], [null, 4.0]]
            ))
          :ladder(
            d.worked_hours - d.banked_hours,
            [[8.0, 2.0], [9.0, 3.0], [null, 4.0]]
          )
  ) ))
)
OVERTIME.rate:
(terms.statutory_work_category == "PIECE_RATE"
  ?max((
    size(earned.months) > 0
      ?sum(
        earned.months.map(
          m,
          m.gross - (has(m.OVERTIME) ? m.OVERTIME : 0.0
        ) )
      )
      /double(size(earned.months))
      :terms.monthly_wage),
    (((has(terms.facts.worksite_region)
    &&terms.facts.worksite_region != ""
      ?terms.facts.worksite_region
      :company.region)
    in rules.minimum_wage.by_region)
      ?rules.minimum_wage.by_region[(has(terms.facts.worksite_region)
      &&terms.facts.worksite_region != ""
        ?terms.facts.worksite_region
        :company.region)]
      :0.0
  ) )
  : (terms.employment_type == "DAILY" && has(terms.facts.daily_wage)
    ?terms.facts.daily_wage
    * (has(terms.facts.working_days_per_week)
    &&terms.facts.working_days_per_week == 6.0
      ?25.0
      :21.0)
    : (terms.monthly_wage
    <0.75
    * (terms.monthly_wage
    + (has(terms.facts.non_fixed_allowances_monthly)
      ?terms.facts.non_fixed_allowances_monthly
      :0.0))
      ?0.75
      * (terms.monthly_wage
      + (has(terms.facts.non_fixed_allowances_monthly)
        ?terms.facts.non_fixed_allowances_monthly
        :0.0))
      :terms.monthly_wage)))
/173.0

entries.instructions: JDIH Setjen DPR RI: search the enacted statute by number and year, open its text and elucidation (penjelasan) and quote the article. Read UU 13/2003 as amended by UU 6/2023 (Cipta Kerja) for the leave classes and their entitlements (annual leave, rest and special leave, maternity and miscarriage leave, paid absences), the wage while not working and its exceptions (the suspension kinds), overtime and rest-day work pay, and the definitions and amounts of the termination payments (pesangon, UPMK, UPH) and fixed-term (PKWT) compensation; read UU 4/2024 on mother-and-child welfare for maternity and paternity leave and their pay.

JDIH Setjen DPR RI: search the enacted statute by number and year, open its text and elucidation (penjelasan) and quote the article. Read UU 36/2008 on income tax as amended by UU 7/2021 (HPP) for employee income-tax withholding (PPh 21): what counts as employment income, the non-taxable allowances (PTKP, art.7) and the rate bands (art.17).

JDIH Setjen DPR RI: search the enacted statute by number and year, open its text and elucidation (penjelasan) and quote the article. Read UU 13/2003 as amended by UU 6/2023 (Cipta Kerja) for working time, daily and weekly rest, overtime limits, child and young-worker limits, women’s night work and the wage-protection provisions (the minimum-wage obligation, deductions); read UU 7/2021 (HPP) amendments to the general tax provisions for how long payroll and tax records must be kept.

JDIH Setjen DPR RI: search the enacted statute by number and year, open its text and elucidation (penjelasan) and quote the article. Read UU 13/2003 as amended by UU 6/2023 (Cipta Kerja) for what an event must cause: work on a weekly rest day or a public holiday, a termination for each reason (which of pesangon, UPMK and UPH it triggers), the end of a fixed-term (PKWT) contract, and the wage during sickness, leave or other paid absence; read UU 4/2024 for what a birth or miscarriage causes.

JDIH Setjen DPR RI: search the enacted statute by number and year, open its text and elucidation (penjelasan) and quote the article. Read UU 13/2003 as amended by UU 6/2023 for the employer’s termination procedure (notice to the worker, bipartite negotiation, notification of the industrial-relations dispute); UU 7/1981 on compulsory manpower reporting; UU 27/2022 on personal data protection for the duties over employee records; and UU 36/2008 as amended by UU 7/2021 for the employer’s duties as PPh 21 withholder (withholding slips, monthly returns and payment).

JDIH Setjen DPR RI: search the enacted statute by number and year, open its text and elucidation (penjelasan) and quote the article. Read UU 13/2003 as amended by UU 6/2023 for the wage provisions the payroll settings follow (the wage period and time of payment, settling wages on termination) and UU 36/2008 as amended by UU 7/2021 for the tax year and the taxpayer identification (NPWP, and the NIK used as NPWP) employees and employers hold.

BPJS Ketenagakerjaan: use Peraturan (/peraturan.html; the PDFs are served under /assets/uploads/peraturan/) and Berita, and quote the regulation article or circular number. Read each programme’s coverage, wage base, rates, shares and ceilings: JHT old-age savings (PP 46/2015 as amended), JKK work accident with its five risk classes (PP 44/2015 as amended by PP 82/2019), JKM death benefit, JP pension (PP 45/2015: rates, the yearly wage ceiling circular each March, the pension age and the continuation election) and JKP job-loss insurance (PP 37/2021 as amended by PP 6/2025). Berita carries the yearly JP ceiling announcement; quote its circular number and effective month.

BPJS Ketenagakerjaan: use Peraturan (/peraturan.html; the PDFs are served under /assets/uploads/peraturan/) and Berita, and quote the regulation article or circular number. Read the employer’s duties: registering the business and its workers, paying the monthly contributions by the 15th of the following month and the late-payment fines, and the stages of a work-accident report (PP 44/2015 as amended by PP 82/2019).

The new UU Pelindungan Ketenagakerjaan (passed by the DPR on 6 October 2026) is research only until it is enacted with a number and a date in force. Record each document’s exact URL, issuer, instrument number, publication and effective dates and the quoted clause or table, read every relevant annex and amendment, OCR a scanned PDF and check its figures visually, treat no press summary as the operative instrument, and try your other registered entries when a page is inaccessible. change_summary: Existing-law correction recorded20October2026, applying to pending October payroll: a still-employed Indonesian JP participant may elect to defer pension benefits and continue JP contributions for at most three years beyond pension age59 (through age61). No election preserves the stop at59. https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/assets/uploads/peraturan/29122015_135819_Permenaker%20Nomor%2029%20Tahun%202015.pdf art3; https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/search.html (retrieved2026-10-20).

allowances.description: Tunjangan tetap: fixed allowances paid with the basic wage; with it they make the monthly wage (terms.monthly_wage) for BPJS, overtime, THR and severance (PP 36/2021 art.7; PP 35/2021 art.32(2)).

employment_type.description: PERMANENT: PKWTT (open-ended); CONTRACT: PKWT (fixed term, UU 13/2003 art.56 as amended by UU 6/2023; PP 35/2021 arts.4–16 — compensation on expiry, no pesangon); PART_TIME: PKWTT or PKWT under 35 hours a week (PP 35/2021 art.21(3)); DAILY: a pegawai tidak tetap paid by the day (PP 35/2021 art.10; PMK 168/2023 art.12(2) TER harian).

work_classification.description: MANAGERIAL: a golongan jabatan tertentu under PP 35/2021 art.27(2) — no overtime wage.

statutory_work_category.description: How the wage is set: by time, by output (satuan hasil, PP 36/2021 art.15) or by task.

residency_status.description: Tax residency (UU PPh art.2(3)–(4)) with nationality: CITIZEN is an Indonesian national resident for tax (PPh 21; JP and PKWT compensation apply); RESIDENT_FOREIGNER a foreigner present more than 183 days in 12 months or intending to reside (PPh 21; no JP); NON_RESIDENT is withheld PPh 26 at 20%. PPh 21 refuses any other value.

facts.description: Stored on the term; CEL reads them as terms.facts.*.

daily_wage.title: Agreed daily wage
daily_wage.description: For a DAILY worker: the day's wage. PPh 21 TER harian is priced on it (PMK 168/2023 art.12(2)), and JHT, JKK and JKM take the month as 25 days of it (PP 44/2015 art.19(3); PP 46/2015 art.17(3)).

working_days_per_week.title: Working days a week
working_days_per_week.description: The working-time system of PP 35/2021 art.21(2): 6 days of 7 hours (40 a week) or 5 days of 8 hours. Prices rest-day and holiday overtime (art.31(2)–(3)); required before such hours are paid.

worksite_kbli.title: Worksite KBLI
worksite_kbli.description: The five-digit KBLI of the worksite's activity; selects the governor's sector minimum wage.

umsp_job_category.title: Job category (sector minimum wage)
umsp_job_category.description: DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 rows 58–59 (bus drivers and mechanics of private companies) and 61 (nursing and midwifery, medical support at a class A private hospital).

tax_subject_from.title: Resident tax subject from
tax_subject_from.description: The day this person became an Indonesian resident tax subject, where that is in the current year (PMK 168/2023 art.15(3)).

tax_subject_until.title: Resident tax subject until
tax_subject_until.description: The last day as an Indonesian resident tax subject, where it ends in the current year (leaving Indonesia for good); that month is the last tax period.

non_fixed_allowances_monthly.title: Non-fixed allowances a month
non_fixed_allowances_monthly.description: Allowances that vary with attendance or output; with basic plus fixed allowances below 75% of the whole wage, overtime is priced on 75% of the whole (PP 35/2021 art.32(4)).

worksite_region.title: Worksite region
worksite_region.description: Where the worker works, as a key of rules.minimum_wage.by_region (“Provinsi X” or “Provinsi X/Kota|Kabupaten Y”). The minimum wage, the sector minimum wage and the BPJS Kesehatan floor are read here (UU 13/2003 art.88E; Perpres 82/2018 art.32); absent, the company region.

hourly_wage.title: Agreed hourly wage
hourly_wage.description: A part-time worker’s hourly wage; at least the monthly minimum ÷ 126 (PP 36/2021 art.16).

probation_months.title: Probation (months)
probation_months.description: The agreed probation period: none in a PKWT, at most 3 months in a PKWTT (UU 13/2003 arts.58, 60).

written_in_indonesian.title: PKWT written in Indonesian
written_in_indonesian.description: The PKWT is in writing in Indonesian and Latin script (UU 13/2003 art.57(1) as amended).

indonesia_work_months_planned.title: Planned months of work in Indonesia
indonesia_work_months_planned.description: For a foreign worker: the planned period of work in Indonesia; under 6 months the worker is insured privately, not by BPJS (UU 24/2011 art.14; PP 34/2021 art.8).

dplk_employee_monthly.title: Employee pension-fund contribution a month
dplk_employee_monthly.description: The employee’s own monthly contribution to an OJK-approved pension fund (DPLK/DPPK), deducted from the year’s gross for PPh 21 (PMK 168/2023 art.10(1)(b)).

weather_dependent.title: Piece work depends on the weather
weather_dependent.description: BPJS averages a piece-rate wage over 12 months instead of 3 (PP 44/2015 art.19(5); PP 46/2015 art.17(5)).

personnel_position.title: Personnel (HR) position
personnel_position.description: The position handles personnel; a foreign worker may not hold it (PP 34/2021 art.11).

dkptka_exempt.title: Exempt from DKPTKA
dkptka_exempt.description: The foreign worker’s position is exempt from the DKPTKA compensation (PP 34/2021).

pre_employment_exam_on.title: Accepted pre-employment examination date
pre_employment_exam_on.description: PER.02/MEN/1980 art.2(7): an examination within the previous three calendar months can remove the need for another pre-employment examination.

pre_employment_exam_accepted.title: Previous examination meets statutory requirements
pre_employment_exam_accepted.description: A physician satisfying art.1(d) performed the recorded examination and there is no doubt about its suitability (art.2(7)). A date alone does not qualify.

dependents_count.description: PTKP dependants (tanggungan, at most three count): PPh 21 TER and PTKP, the Coretax status (K/n, TK/n) and the detention family aid read it (UU PPh art.7(1)).

fixed_term.description: A fixed-term contract: while true the employment is not permanent (`permanent_when`).

exit_facts.description: Stored on employment_contract.exit_facts; CEL reads them as employment.exit_facts.*.

termination_cause.title: PP 35/2021 termination cause
termination_cause.description: The statutory ground (PP 35/2021 arts.41–57); it chooses the pesangon multiplier and whether UPMK or uang pisah is owed. Required for a PKWTT exit.

separation_wage_basis.title: Separation wage basis
separation_wage_basis.description: PP 35/2021 art.157 basis: the monthly wage (basic plus fixed allowances), 30 × a daily wage, or the 12-month output average floored at the regional minimum wage (rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region]).

separation_daily_wage.title: Daily wage for separation
separation_daily_wage.description: Art.157(2): the separation month is 30 times this daily wage.

micro_small_enterprise.title: Micro or small enterprise
micro_small_enterprise.description: PP 35/2021 art.59: a micro or small enterprise pays the severance agreed with the worker instead of the statutory formula.

separation_pay_amount.title: Contract-defined separation pay (uang pisah)
separation_pay_amount.description: PP 35/2021 arts.50–54: the amount the agreement, company regulation or collective agreement fixes.

pension_offset_applies.title: Employer-funded pension offset applies
pension_offset_applies.description: PP 35/2021 art.58: an employer pension programme's benefit is set against the separation pay.

notice_given_on.title: Termination notice given on
notice_given_on.description: The day the written termination notice reached the worker (PP 35/2021 art.37(3)–(4)).

in_probation.title: Dismissed during probation
in_probation.description: The notice period is 7 working days instead of 14 (PP 35/2021 art.37(4)).

kind.description: The participant registration with the scheme (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan or Kesehatan). A missing registration does not waive a contribution (UU 24/2011 art.19).

reference_number.description: The KPJ (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan) or JKN card number.

extra_members.title: Extra BPJS Kesehatan family members
extra_members.description: KESEHATAN: family members beyond the spouse and three children the worker enrols (Perpres 82/2018 arts.30(1)(b), 36): 1% of the capped wage each, deducted from the worker.

continue_after_pension_age.title: Continue JP after pension age
continue_after_pension_age.description: JP only: for an Indonesian citizen still employed at age59–61 who has notified BPJS of the choice to defer pension benefits and continue contributions. Record true only for the confirmed election. Contributions must stop no later than three years after pension age (age62 in2026). Permenaker29/2015 art3(3)–(4); PP45/2015 art15(4).

reason.description: Why the standing is what it is (e.g. the source evidence for a missing registration).

facts.description: Stored as the other keys of employment_profile.facts; CEL reads them as employee.facts.*. PTKP reads the profile columns marital_status and dependents_count (at most three) and gender: MARRIED is status K; with the dependants it fixes the TER category (A = TK/0, TK/1, K/0; B = TK/2, TK/3, K/1, K/2; C = K/3).

husband_no_income_certified.title: Husband has no income (kelurahan statement)
husband_no_income_certified.description: A married female employee takes PTKP TK/0 unless she holds a statement from the kelurahan/desa that her husband receives no income; then she takes K plus her dependants (PMK 168/2023; UU PPh art.8(1)).

zakat_monthly.title: Zakat paid through the employer a month
zakat_monthly.description: Zakat or a compulsory religious contribution paid through the employer to a recognised body; deducted from gross income (PMK 168/2023 art.10(1)(c)).

pph26_treaty_rate.title: PPh 26 treaty rate
pph26_treaty_rate.description: The tax-treaty rate for a non-resident who has given the certificate of domicile (PMK 168/2023 art.14(1)–(2)).

tax_id_validated.title: NPWP or DJP-validated NIK
tax_id_validated.description: True when the employee has an NPWP or a NIK validated by DJP; false applies the 20% higher rate (UU 36/2008 art.21(5a)) and bars the DTP incentive (PMK 105/2025 art.4).

pph21_dtp_reference_gross.title: DTP reference gross
pph21_dtp_reference_gross.description: The fixed and regular gross of January of the incentive year, or of the first month worked in it (PMK 105/2025 art.4(2)(b); PMK 10/2025 art.4(2)(b)).

pph21_dtp_reference_year.title: DTP reference year
pph21_dtp_reference_year.description: The year the DTP reference gross was measured in.

night_work_pregnancy_risk.title: Pregnant, night work a risk (doctor)
night_work_pregnancy_risk.description: A doctor certifies that night work endangers the pregnancy or the worker (UU 13/2003 art.76(2)).

passport_number.title: Passport number
passport_number.description: A foreign employee’s passport (Coretax CounterpartPassport on BPMP, BPA1 and BP26).

foreign_tin.title: Foreign tax identification number
foreign_tin.description: A non-resident’s TIN in the country of residence (Coretax BP26 CounterpartTin); blank = the passport number.

bp26_country.title: Country of residence (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3)
bp26_country.description: A non-resident’s country on the Coretax BP26 (CounterpartCountry, e.g. USA).

birth_city.title: City of birth
birth_city.description: A non-resident’s birth city on the Coretax BP26 (CounterpartBirthCity).

bp21_tax_object_code.title: BP21 tax object code of a bukan pegawai
bp21_tax_object_code.description: The DJP tax object code of a non-employee’s fees on the Coretax BP21 (BP21 converter REF sheet, deemed 50%); blank = 21-100-20, services in any field.

loan_facts.description: Stored on loan_catalog_entry.facts; the CEL root `entry.facts` of the loan class's rules.

written_agreement_reference.title: Written loan agreement
written_agreement_reference.description: PP 36/2021 art. 65: the written agreement a payroll loan deduction requires.

entity_input_schema.title: ID entity inputs
entity_input_schema.description: Stored on entity.facts; CEL reads them as company.facts.*. The entity columns region (a key of rules.minimum_wage.by_region: the BPJS Kesehatan floor and the art.157 output floor) and risk_class (JKK group I–V, PP 44/2015 art.16(1)) are read beside them.

leave_cash_out_day_divisor.title: Leave cash-out daily divisor
leave_cash_out_day_divisor.description: The number of days the basic wage is divided by to value one day of unused annual leave (owner ruling: basic ÷ this divisor), at most 25 — the PP 36/2021 art.17 divisor of a six-day week, so a day is never valued below it. Required before any annual leave is cashed out (UU 13/2003 art.79; PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(a)).

enterprise_size_class.title: Enterprise size for BPJS Kesehatan
enterprise_size_class.description: Perpres 82/2018 art.32(4)–(5) as amended by Perpres 59/2024: micro and small enterprises are outside the ordinary UMP/UMK contribution floor.

npwp.title: Employer NPWP
npwp.description: The withholder's tax identity on SPT Masa PPh 21/26 and BPA1 (16 digits from 2024; PMK 112/2022).

nib.title: Nomor Induk Berusaha
nib.description: The OSS business identity (PP 5/2021); WLKP and PKWT registration key on it.

bpjs_ketenagakerjaan_npp.title: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan NPP
bpjs_ketenagakerjaan_npp.description: Employer registration number (nomor pendaftaran perusahaan) for JHT, JKK, JKM, JP and JKP.

bpjs_kesehatan_kode_badan_usaha.title: BPJS Kesehatan employer code
bpjs_kesehatan_kode_badan_usaha.description: The badan usaha code of the employer's BPJS Kesehatan registration.

wlkp_registration.title: WLKP registration number
wlkp_registration.description: Wajib Lapor Ketenagakerjaan di Perusahaan registration (UU 7/1981; Permenaker 18/2017).

wlkp_first_reported_on.title: First WLKP report
wlkp_first_reported_on.description: The day the company first reported under UU 7/1981 art.6; the annual report falls on its anniversary (art.8).

company_regulation_valid_until.title: Company regulations valid until
company_regulation_valid_until.description: The last day of the ratified Peraturan Perusahaan (at most 2 years, UU 13/2003 art.111(3)).

umsp_export_oriented.title: Exporter (sector minimum wage)
umsp_export_oriented.description: A Keterangan condition of the DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran; record it only where the employer meets it.

umsp_assets_over_1_trillion.title: Assets above Rp1 trillion (sector minimum wage)
umsp_assets_over_1_trillion.description: A Keterangan condition of the DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran; record it only where the employer meets it.

umsp_astra_group.title: Astra group member (sector minimum wage)
umsp_astra_group.description: A Keterangan condition of the DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran; record it only where the employer meets it.

umsp_class_a_private_hospital.title: Class A private hospital (sector minimum wage)
umsp_class_a_private_hospital.description: A Keterangan condition of the DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran; record it only where the employer meets it.

umsp_hotel_star.title: Hotel star class (sector minimum wage)
umsp_hotel_star.description: DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran row 60: star hotels of 4 and 5 stars; Banten Kep. 704/2025 Lampiran V (Kota Tangerang sector 3): 3, 4 and 5 stars. Sumatera Utara Kep. 188.44/909/KPTS/2025 annex XI (Medan): exact 3-, 4- or 5-star class selects a separate rate.

klu.title: Main KLU (DJP)
klu.description: The main business classification code in the DJP database (on 1 January of the year, or the registration day): selects the PPh 21 DTP incentive (PMK 105/2025 art.3; PMK 10/2025 art.3).

jkk_labour_intensive_industry.title: Labour-intensive industry (JKK discount)
jkk_labour_intensive_industry.description: The PP 7/2025 art.3(4) industry, as BPJS Ketenagakerjaan verified it: with 50 or more active participants the JKK is halved for wage months up to January 2026 (PP 36/2025 art.10A).

managerial_group_defined.title: Golongan jabatan tertentu defined
managerial_group_defined.description: The employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement defines the art.27(2) managerial group exempt from overtime pay (PP 35/2021 art.27(4)–(5)).

lks_bipartit_formed_on.title: LKS Bipartit formed on
lks_bipartit_formed_on.description: The day the bipartite cooperation body was formed (UU 13/2003 art.106).

k3_high_hazard.title: High hazard potential
k3_high_hazard.description: The workplace has a high hazard potential: SMK3 applies whatever the headcount (PP 50/2012 art.5(2)).

long_leave_granted.title: Long leave granted
long_leave_granted.description: The employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement grants long leave (UU 13/2003 art.79(5) as amended).

dkptka_usd_idr_rate.title: DKPTKA USD rate
dkptka_usd_idr_rate.description: Rupiah per US dollar the DKPTKA (USD 100 a foreign worker a month) is paid at.

construction_services.title: Construction services (jasa konstruksi)
construction_services.description: The employer is in the construction-services sector (PP 44/2015 art.1(10), BAB VI): its daily, piece, task and PKWT workers pay JKK at 1.74% of the monthly wage (art.54(1)).

umsp_rayon_viscose.title: Rayon viscose staple fibre (sector minimum wage)
umsp_rayon_viscose.description: Kep. Gubernur Jawa Barat 561.7/Kep.876-Kesra/2025, Purwakarta: KBLI 20302 rayon viscose (5,193,876) rather than polyester (5,062,344); record it only where the worksite makes rayon viscose.

nitku.title: ID TKU (NITKU)
nitku.description: The 22-digit place-of-business identity of the withholder on Coretax slips (IDPlaceOfBusinessActivity); blank = the NPWP + 000000 of the head office.

umsp_freeport_area.title: Works in the PT Freeport Indonesia area (Mimika sector minimum wage)
umsp_freeport_area.description: Kep. Gubernur Papua Tengah 100.3.3.1/337/2025 diktum KETIGA (2026: any company) and 258/2024 diktum KESATU 3 (2025: a construction company): a company working in the PT Freeport Indonesia area pays the Mimika mining sector minimum wage. Unrecorded is false.

umsp_bank_category.title: Bank category (sector minimum wage)
umsp_bank_category.description: Medan annex XI of Kep. 188.44/909/KPTS/2025: private conventional foreign-exchange bank (printed KBLI 2015 64125, KBLI 2020 64121), foreign-exchange syariah bank (2015 64131, 2020 64122), or another bank. Declare actual licensed status; the broader KBLI 2020 code does not establish it.
